query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_fit,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_fit,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NOT NULL AND briefData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NOT NULL AND salesApproachData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_sales
FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003);
